build_ithaca_transformer_model: build a transformer model for sequence tagging with character and word embeddings using Flax and JAX
create_model_forward_pass: create a forward pass through the Ithaca model with character and word token inputs to produce date, region, and mask logits
test_model_with_padding: test the Ithaca model forward pass with padding masks and configurable dropout for training and inference modes
refactor_model_output_heads: refactor the Ithaca model output heads to support date distribution, subregion classification, character-level masking, and next-sentence prediction
review_model_bigbird_attention: review the Ithaca model BigBird sparse attention encoder blocks with configurable heads, layers, and MLP dimensions
